title: File:Six foot track megalong valley.JPG
claims: The image shows a narrow walking track running through golden grass on a hillside, with green trees, a forested ridge and a blue sky beyond.

The Commons file identifies the Six Foot Track in Megalong Valley; it contains no UTA race context. The UTA100 timing chart names Six Foot Track Outbound at 37.3 km and a Six Foot Track Water Point at 45.7 km, but the file has no GPS coordinates, so the photograph cannot be placed at either kilometre.

The author is Schomynv; the work is released into the public domain; the original is 2,560 x 1,920 pixels and 3.15 MB; the photograph was taken in April 2010 and uploaded on 2010-05-03; the file has no camera coordinates.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 thumbnail of 235,390 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author and source; attribution is not legally required but is given.
